The center of mass is the same thing as center of gravity, but since we are in space there is no gravity so we say center of mass instead, its the same thing. The center of mass is the balance point of an object. If you could hang the object on a rope attached to that point it would just stay like that, without trying to twist - in other words it will stay balanced.

This is something we often have to deal with on Earth as well. For example we want the wheels on our cars to be balanced, otherwise they wobble as they rotate and cause danger. This is why wheel balancing is important. When balancing a wheel they spin it first to see how it wobbles, then they place weights at specific spots until all the mass around the wheel is equal and it doesn't wobble any more. Basically what they are doing is shifting the center of mass until it aligns with the center of rotation. Check out how this guy balances the wheels of his motorcycle. You will notice that the wheel became balanced when he added enough weight to drag the center of mass exactly to the center of the wheel. So much for center of mass and balance.
